script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function()
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.isLevelPassed(43) and global.isLevelPassed(45) then
		if global.getBool("stg_b3") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("54-1")
			if dialog.show("Stage3F-1", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage3F-2", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage3F-3", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage3F-4", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage3F-5", faceShengqi) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("58-1")
			global.setBool("stg_b3")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    end
    game.success()
end
